title: Trace the European helper field and both unowned dispatch tables
changes: Verified all six direct helper setter calls and three indexed writes. Traced the nested list to 24 EWRAM input records under a valid selector and identified the existing 11-template bank used when allocating the indexed list.
Joined six switch tables containing 210 entries against e345. Two complete tables with 18 entries and both root words leave 80 unowned bytes. Ten unowned producer words add 40 bytes.
validation: Wine slfj198b, ehtmtokr and 8ajybsq0 pass with 8,837, 804 and 1,303 added halfwords and 38, 42 and 46 input guards. Each Wine server drains. Guarded e345 join mdd2l_wy passes all 44 input guards.
limitations: Runtime integration, exact live selected handles and mode-2 list entries, aliases and remaining pointer families, ordinary and generated dispatch, original BIOS, Linux and USA remain open. No performance measurement.
